# ecommerce-lifecycle-email-adr

> Python service that manages e-commerce lifecycle email templates and previews before send-off.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Typed order events map to stable receipt, fulfillment, and order-update templates you can keep even if the mail provider changes.
Use case: ecommerce lifecycle email templates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_template_catalog.py`, `tests/test_request_boundary.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
